title: Civil, Technical Lead
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.

Technical Projects Director – Civil Technical Lead
  
  

Job Description Summary
  
  

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Civil Technical Lead with a strong background in civil infrastructure design, engineering review, and project delivery for critical infrastructure projects. As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for reviewing, coordinating, and providing technical leadership for civil engineering systems throughout the design and construction lifecycle of large\-scale infrastructure developments, preferably data centres.
  
  

This is an exciting opportunity for a technically proficient individual looking to excel in a regional role based in Singapore. You will serve as a technical lead, managing multiple project activities while collaborating closely with Clients, Consultants, Contractors, Utility Authorities, and Internal Stakeholders to support the successful development of new\-build data centres across the APAC region.
  
Only candidates with full fluency in English, experience in Technical Projects and Engineering / Construction Management, and without restrictions to work in Singapore will be considered.
  
  

Job Description
  
  

**Description:**  

Review, comment on, and provide technical guidance for Civil engineering designs and development plans, including roads and site geometry, paving design, surface water drainage, foul and industrial drainage systems, underground utility networks, electrical distribution systems (HV, MV, LV and ELV), pressure pipe distribution systems (hydrants, potable water, industrial water and blowdown), and fibre distribution networks.
  
Act as the primary point of contact and Client Representative for Civil engineering\-related matters, collaborating closely with internal teams, client stakeholders, consultants, contractors, utility authorities, and external partners throughout the project lifecycle.
  
Report all issues, progress updates, technical concerns, and blocking items to the Technical Program Manager and Civil Technical Lead. Support project delivery through proactive issue management and effective stakeholder communication.
  
Support and monitor design development and construction activities to ensure compliance with approved designs, client requirements, engineering standards, local regulations, utility authority requirements, environmental conditions, and project specifications.
  
Review engineering submissions and construction documentation for technical accuracy, constructability, coordination, quality, and compliance with applicable standards and project objectives.
  
Identify potential design, utility, coordination, permitting, and construction issues at an early stage and recommend practical solutions to minimize technical, schedule, cost, and operational risks.
  
Attend design coordination meetings and provide continual input to optimize civil infrastructure designs, improve constructability, and support efficient project execution.
  
Review and comment on project documentation, including drawings, calculations, technical reports, specifications, scopes of work, contractor submissions, studies, and design deliverables.
  
Support engineering decision\-making through technical assessments, design reviews, risk evaluations, constructability analysis, value engineering initiatives, and design optimization opportunities.
  
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including Architectural, CSA, Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, EHS, Security, Network, and Operations teams to maintain alignment across all project interfaces.
  
Coordinate with consultants, contractors, utility providers, and approved vendors to ensure designs, equipment selections, and construction activities align with project requirements, standards, and client expectations.
  
Utilize established QA/QC review processes, checklists, trackers, and document management systems to perform peer reviews and maintain design quality throughout project delivery.
  
Escalate known design and construction issues impacting scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, or operational requirements, ensuring effective communication and timely resolution across all stakeholders.
  
Maintain technical logs and records of project risks, design changes, site issues, technical queries, and engineering decisions, including preparation of reports, studies, assessments, and presentations outlining potential impacts and recommended resolutions.
  
Support the timely review, coordination, acceptance, and close\-out of design and construction deliverables to achieve project milestones and schedule commitments.
  
Oversee compliance with local planning requirements, permitting conditions, environmental regulations, utility authority requirements, and project\-specific standards.
  
Provide administrative assistance with project documentation, revision control, deliverable tracking, document management, and maintenance of project records within approved project collaboration platforms.
  
  

**Requirements:**  

Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
  
Professional Engineer (PE), Chartered Engineer (CEng), or equivalent professional accreditation preferred.
  
Minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in civil engineering design, infrastructure development, technical project delivery, or engineering management for large\-scale infrastructure projects.
  
Strong technical knowledge of civil engineering systems including roads, earthworks, site grading, drainage systems, utility infrastructure, pressure pipe networks, and underground services coordination.
  
Experience reviewing and coordinating multidisciplinary engineering designs for mission\-critical, industrial, infrastructure, or data centre projects.
  
Proficiency in industry\-standard design and coordination tools such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Revit, Navisworks, BIM360, Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), and related design management platforms.
  
Comprehensive understanding of engineering codes, standards, permitting processes, utility requirements, environmental regulations, and construction practices.
  
Experience conducting design reviews, constructability assessments, technical risk analysis, and value engineering studies.
  
Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate stakeholders, and meet project deadlines.
  
Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities with strong attention to detail.
  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively engage Clients, Consultants, Contractors, Utility Authorities, and cross\-functional project teams.
  
Previous experience supporting the development and delivery of hyperscale data centres or other critical infrastructure facilities will be highly advantageous.
  
  

If you meet our requirements and are excited about working on critical infrastructure projects, please submit your resume, portfolio, and references. We look forward to hearing from you!
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Job Overview**

We are looking for a **Senior** **SDET** to test the resilience and correctness of distributed backend systems supporting a high\-stakes account provisioning and onboarding workflow. This role is focused on the execution of pre\-approved, benign tracer/replay scenarios against staging endpoints, analysis of request/response behaviour, and documentation of observable account/CID lifecycle and downstream state behaviour.


The ideal candidate has strong distributed\-systems and API\-testing experience and maintains disciplined technical evidence capture and traceability.


This role is not intended to perform unrestricted adversarial testing. Testing activities will be limited to approved staging environments and pre\-approved benign scenarios.  



  

**Project Details**  

  

**Title:** Senior SDET  

**Rate:** $13\.5/hr
  

**Start Date:** 19th October  

**Duration:** 5 Weeks  

**Commitment**: 33 Hours per Week  

**Location:** India (Remote)  

**Job Type:** Freelance

### **Responsibilities**

* Analyze distributed system APIs to validate correctness, consistency, and failure handling across services involved in account creation, data persistence, and related record\-linking
* Execute pre\-approved request variations and boundary\-validation scenarios using sanitized tracer payloads against designated staging endpoints.
* Investigate system behavior under malformed, malicious, or unexpected inputs and document findings clearly
* Capture complete request/response evidence, including HTTP status codes, latency, headers, and payload bodies, subject to approved data\-handling requirements.
* Validate behavior of near\-real\-time inline checks (evaluated within milliseconds at the gateway) as distinct from longer\-running background verification/risk pipelines (evaluated over minutes to hours), confirming each layer of defense behaves as expected
* Verify data persistence, referential integrity, and correct linkage of related records/relationships written by backend services during processing
* Execute controlled replay suites and compare expected versus observed API behavior.
* Correlate replay results with the API schemas and network evidence produced by the Middleware SDET.
* Document observable account/CID lifecycle behavior and downstream state changes for handoff
* Capture and archive test logs and evidence in a structured, retrievable format to support audits and post\-incident reviews
* Collaborate with backend engineering teams to reproduce, isolate, and validate fixes for distributed\-system defects
* Contribute to test strategy for backend/middleware reliability, including failure\-mode and chaos\-style testing
* Maintain traceability between test evidence, defects, and system requirements
* Reconcile backend observations with the frontend FSM and middleware/API evidence produced by earlier workstreams.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Strong experience of **5\-8\+ years** in testing distributed systems and analyzing inter\-service API behavior
* Hands\-on experience with request payload tampering, fuzzing, or adversarial API testing techniques
* Understanding of layered defense architectures, including the distinction between synchronous/inline validation and asynchronous/background verification processes
* Familiarity with testing data persistence and relational/hierarchical integrity in backend data stores
* Demonstrated discipline in test log archival, evidence capture, and structured documentation practices
* Solid understanding of backend/middleware architecture, failure modes, and system boundaries
* Familiarity with API testing tools and scripting for building custom fuzzing/tampering test cases
* Strong analytical and investigative skills for root\-causing complex, systemic defects
* Experience executing controlled API replay or staging validation is strongly preferred.
* Experience correlating API responses with observable application/account lifecycle states is preferred.
* Experience supporting audit, compliance, or evidence\-based reporting requirements is a plus

title: Lead Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Overview**


We are seeking a Lead SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test ) to provide end\-to\-end technical governance across all QA layers — frontend, middleware, and backend — for a complex, multi\-layered onboarding platform. This role owns the architecture of API contract testing and the data modeling of complex entity relationships (e.g., hierarchical/parent\-child style structures), while ensuring that quality assumptions made at one layer (such as client\-side validation) are independently verified at every downstream layer rather than trusted at face value. The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership with the ability to set and enforce delivery governance across cross\-functional teams.


**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provide technical governance across frontend, middleware, and backend testing layers.
* Establish and enforce QA delivery standards, evidence requirements, review processes, and quality gates.
* Review frontend constraint dictionaries and FSM/state\-model outputs for completeness and consistency.
* Review API schema reconstructions, network evidence, and tracer replay outputs for technical quality and traceability.
* Coordinate with QA Analysts, SDETs, and Test Operations Associates to align technical execution with delivery timelines.
* Review test architecture decisions, validation approaches, and coverage strategies.
* Coordinate dependency resolution, evidence rework, and cross\-layer reconciliation throughout the engagement.
* Act as the escalation point for cross\-layer technical discrepancies and evidence\-quality issues.
* Compile and quality\-check the raw technical evidence dossiers produced by the workstreams.
* Identify evidence gaps, inconsistencies, or areas requiring rework before handoff to client stakeholders.
* Report on delivery health, technical risks, evidence quality, dependencies, and unresolved gaps.
* Prepare the technical evidence package for handoff to the client team responsible for final modelling and logic\-gap assessment.
* Support technical readout preparation by ensuring that findings are traceable to empirical evidence.

**Project Details**

**Title**: Lead SDET **Rate:** $17/hr  

**Start Date:** 19th October  

**Duration:** 4 Months  

**Commitment:** 22 Hours per Week  

**Location:** India (Remote)  

**Job Type:** Contractual (with the possibility of a Full\-time employment extension based on performance and project needs)

**QUALIFICATIONS:**


* Proven experience of 8\+ years in a QA leadership role spanning multiple testing layers (frontend, middleware, backend)
* Demonstrated expertise in API contract testing architecture and governance
* Practical experience with knowledge graph or entity\-relationship data modeling and its application to test/data traceability
* Strong understanding of layered system architectures and the importance of independently verifying quality at each layer rather than relying on upstream assumptions
* Strong track record of technical delivery governance, including setting standards and quality gates
* Excellent cross\-functional leadership and stakeholder communication skills
* Deep technical grounding across QA disciplines (manual, automation, systems\-level testing) to credibly guide teams at every layer
* Experience mentoring or managing SDETs and QA Analysts
* Experience leading complex multi\-week technical QA, API validation, or security\-assessment engagements is strongly preferred.
* Experience establishing evidence/traceability models across complex technical workflows is preferred.
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs, entity\-relationship models, or structured technical dependency/evidence modeling is preferred; deep knowledge\-graph engineering expertise is not required.
* Ability to synthesize technical evidence into concise stakeholder\-ready findings and handoff materials.

The Product Engineer designs and builds the digital products that farmers, field teams, programme partners, and BCI teams rely on to collect data and carry out field activities. the following skills, knowledge, and experience:

Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1\-page maximum) by or before **08\.10\.2026** via the application link.

Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. description:
Overview:
**WELCOME TO SITA**
-------------------

  

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.  

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.  

Are you ready to love your job?  

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.**PURPOSE**
-----------


Coordinates and oversees the resolution of critical incidents ensuring minimal business impact and swift restoration of services through structured processes and effective communication (and triggers crisis management process).**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

* As Senior Analyst, Incident Management, you will serve as the operational control tower for Major Incidents and Priority 1 incidents across the Digital Customer Organization (DCO) and Portfolio Service Operations (PSO). You will establish command and control, coordinate the right technical and business resources, and maintain a disciplined focus on restoring customer services while minimizing operational, financial, reputational, and customer impact.
* You will be accountable for the quality and pace of end\-to\-end major incident governance, including impact assessment, stakeholder mobilization, technical and customer bridge management, escalation, communications, recovery validation, documentation, and post\-incident follow\-through. You will support the accountable Incident Manager and ensure that resolver teams retain ownership of technical diagnosis and remediation.
* Reporting to the Manager, Major Incident Management, you will be part of the Digital Customer Organization (DCO)function responsible for service resilience, customer confidence, consistent global incident response, and the continued transformation and maturity of Incident Management.
* You will collaborate with DCO Service Desks, PSO resolver teams, Customer Service Managers (CSO), Site Reliability Engineers (SRE), Service Practice Owners, Product and Engineering teams, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Vendor Management (VMO), suppliers, and senior stakeholders. Through these partnerships, you will strengthen DCO and PSO integration, improve operational handovers, and convert incident learning into sustainable service improvements.
* Lead and coordinate Major Incidents and P1 incidents from declaration through service restoration and formal closure, maintaining a clear command structure, accurate situational awareness, and momentum toward recovery.
* Rapidly evaluate technical, customer, and business impact; validate priority; initiate the appropriate Major Incident or crisis pathway; and ensure compliance with agreed SLAs, OLAs, customer commitments, and escalation procedures.
* Mobilize and coordinate DCO, PSO, SRE, Product, Engineering, vendor, supplier, and specialist resolver teams, establishing clear accountabilities, time\-bound actions, dependencies, and escalation points.
* Establish and facilitate technical, customer, and management bridges, keeping discussions outcome\-focused, recording decisions and actions, challenging stalled progress, and escalating risks, resource gaps, or conflicting priorities.
* Deliver accurate, concise, and timely communications for customers, operations, senior leadership, and executives, clearly presenting impact, recovery actions, workarounds, risks, assumptions, estimated next updates, and service status.
* Maintain a complete and auditable incident record in the ITSM platform, including business impact, chronology, ownership, decisions, evidence, communications, recovery validation, links to related Problems and Changes, and closure details.
* Produce high\-quality Post\-Major Incident Reports (PMIRs), executive summaries, and post\-incident review packs; facilitate blameless learning reviews that identify control gaps, contributing factors, and practical opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate Root Cause Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) with Problem Management and technical owners, ensuring actions are risk\-based, measurable, assigned, due\-dated, tracked, and closed only after effectiveness is verified.
* Analyze incident performance and trends, including MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, repeat incidents, business impact, communication timeliness, escalation quality, action ageing, and customer feedback; translate insights into prioritized improvement plans.
* Advance the maturity of Incident Management through playbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, templates, simulations, training, automation opportunities, governance reviews, and stronger integration across DCO, PSO, SRE, CSO, VMO, and Service Practices.


Qualifications:
**EXPERIENCE**
--------------


Preferably 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in a customer\-focused service or support role within a large\-scale enterprise environment. Experience should include Customer Support, Service Desk, Help Desk, Call Centre, Incident Management, Service Operations, NOC, Command Centre, or IT Operations. **NICE TO HAVE*** ITIL 4 Foundation/Practitioner, SRE, Agile, DevOps, Lean, Six Sigma, or related Service Management certifications.
* Experience supporting mission\-critical environments such as aviation, travel technology, telecommunications, cloud services, managed infrastructure, SaaS platforms, or financial services, with exposure to executive communications, crisis management, and business continuity processes.
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, observability and monitoring tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, etc), operational analytics, AI Ops, and Incident Management transformation initiatives.
  

Candidates should demonstrate strong customer engagement skills and practical experience supporting a broad range of services and products at intermediate to advanced levels. Experience or working knowledge of airline and travel industry operations, applications, and customer service environments is highly desirable.**KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS**
-----------------------

**IT Service Management Knowledge**

* Advanced practical understanding of ITIL\-based Incident and Major Incident Management, including interfaces with Problem, Change, Event, Knowledge, Service Level and Continual Improvement practices.
* Understanding of service management governance, SLAs/OLAs, operational acceptance, service transition, risk and control frameworks.
* Proficiency with enterprise ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or equivalent, collaboration tools, reporting dashboards and knowledge repositories.

You will work across multiple SIEM platforms and sectors, with direct access to the CTO and real influence over our in\-house product roadmap.

**What you'll be doing**

* Baseline and improve detection coverage for assigned customers against MITRE ATT\&CK and their own risk profile
* Author, test, version and maintain detection content across multiple SIEM platforms
* Determine the log sources and telemetry needed for a given detection outcome and troubleshoot integrations, parsers and data quality
* Work directly with customers to translate their business risk into monitoring requirements a SOC analyst can act on
* Build the correlation layer that connects our security services to one another (e.g. turning dark web credential exposures into tuned identity detections)
* Track the threat landscape and build a reusable detection library so work for one customer raises the baseline for all

**What you'll need**

*You don't need to tick every box below, but most of these should describe you:*

* 6\+ years in cybersecurity, with real hands\-on experience in security operations, SIEM engineering or detection content
* Deep, practical experience with at least one enterprise SIEM (e.g. Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, IBM QRadar, Elastic Security, Google SecOps, Sumo Logic) and confidence working across more than one
* Demonstrable experience authoring detection logic in a query language such as KQL, SPL, EQL, Lucene, YARA\-L or Sigma
* Strong working knowledge of MITRE ATT\&CK used for coverage and gap analysis, not just as a reporting label
* Practical understanding of log sources across Windows, Linux, cloud platforms, identity systems, network, email and EDR
* Ability to hold a credible conversation with a customer about their business and convert it into monitoring requirements
* Clear written and spoken English

**Nice to have**

* Python or PowerShell scripting; detection\-as\-code workflows using Git and CI pipelines
* Purple team experience, or use of Atomic Red Team, Caldera or a commercial breach and attack simulation platform
* Structured, hypothesis\-driven threat hunting experience
* Identity security experience (identity governance, privileged access, privileged account monitoring)
* Cloud or detection certifications (AZ\-500, SC\-200, AWS Security Specialty, GCDA, GCIA, GCFA, GCED, OSCP)

**What we offer**

* Genuine ownership of a new discipline, reporting directly to the CTO
* Breadth across multiple customers, sectors and SIEM platforms
* A funded training and certification budget
* Standard business hours, no shift work and no on\-call rota (with regular calls overlapping into the UK afternoon/evening, roughly 1:30pm\-9:30pm IST)
